title: Core Drawing 001 — observe and compare a cup opening
alt_text: Two vertically stacked light graphite cup drawings, with a small fixed-view photo inset and a leader pointing toward the upper opening. The upper opening is flatter than the photo; the lower is more open and closer to it. Body and handle outlines vary slightly between drawings.
caption: Compare how flat the upper opening looks with the fixed-view photo; the lower opening is more open. Body and handle contours vary slightly between drawings. No shading or finish is expected.
